cards.speaker: James
cards.text: {faction} are warmer, not safe. One more push and a raid becomes an awkward phone call.

cards.speaker: James
cards.text: We took the heat out of {faction}. Keep it out. Their patience is a lease, not a deed.

cards.speaker: James
cards.text: Round two with {faction}. Same ground, same buyers, and they've not forgotten. Neither should we.
